thesis: The pages show a long, repetitive series of publish to-dos for fixture folders on the same account, several of them closed as duplicates or as the agent's own tasks, and none of them show fixtures-index-v4 itself. Until a live Hugging Face page or the folder in the repository can be fetched, this reads as a plan rather than a finished artifact.
